summary: PR #9439 (diff from its base 6f2c65fc to ef8b3750) runs the kit image build and cosign under a login-free Docker config so a stale ghcr.io login stops failing public reads, but two other host builds of the same public images still send that login.
title: fix(vm-template): build past a registry login GHCR refuses

must_flag.why: line 43 runs `docker build` of engine.Dockerfile under the user's own DOCKER_CONFIG, so the stored ghcr.io login the PR bypasses for the kit build still reaches this public read.
base line 771 (head 792, in _vm_rescue_export, not the PR's wrapper hunk at head 225-241) runs `docker buildx build` of the signed image with the stored login, the same mechanism.
